release_notes:
Test release for **Honista v13 complete local fixes**.

Download `honista-patches-1.0.0.mpp`, import it into Morphe Manager as a **Local patch source**, then select the original Honista v13 ARM64 APK and the complete fixes patch. The repository is now public and includes `patches-bundle.json`. Add `https://github.com/Manishrdy/honista-patches` as a Remote patch source, or use the local MPP import above.

Supported input:
- Package: `cc.honista.app`
- Version: `426.0.0.37.69`, code `383207253`
- Original APK SHA-256: `42d28e1b08b4ba10de460dad4e9230cf00909ad7c6f578d5a50f86eb1b7876b3`

Includes the implemented local premium eligibility/UI changes, forced remove-ad/remove-suggested controls, Honista ad adapters, Instagram sponsored/injected-media filtering, and retained startup/module/Android-ID/country/quality/profile fixes. Package/version/class fingerprint checks reject unsupported or already-patched inputs.

Validation: successfully patched using official Morphe Desktop 1.18.1 in its default mode. All 25 changed/added classes and the module asset match the tested build. The committed source builds without the ignored APK, analysis, decoded tree, or existing generated outputs. Phone-side Manager UI testing is still pending.

To update your existing installation without losing app data, sign the resulting APK with the same existing keystore. The APK signing key is not included in this release or repository. See [the usage guide](https://github.com/Manishrdy/honista-patches/blob/main/honista-patches/README.md) for import/build/signing details.

MPP SHA-256: `ee216b0a27bb060ca86c68b28b04b486fce81219af9edbdfb17072327e6d0eb4`.
